_roster_note: Operator 2026-10-09 design, event-driven (no clocked launches; critic sessions only for a waiting claim; failed sessions replaced at once). Ideas: every model. Flash and K3 proposers work under the coordinator (operator 2026-10-11: six coordinator-launched research slots per run, two Flash ideas, two K3 ideas, two Flash literature; problems 1 and 2 were supply-limited at three); GLM and Qwen are self-directed explorers nobody waits for. Review (acceptance.mode pair): each claim goes to one Flash critic and one K3 critic in parallel, each told to judge independently. Both accept -> verified; both reject -> refuted; both object (or reject + objection) -> needs-repair; one accepts and the other rejects or objects -> a fresh K3 tie-break session (acceptance.tiebreak.model) sees the claim and, when acceptance.tiebreak.show_critiques, the two critiques without author, model or verdict label; its verdict settles the claim. Coordinator Flash (logs: 0.8-1.4 min per decision, 1 failed of 401; K3 1.0-2.1 min, 39 failed of 1008; roster.coordinator k3 restores K3). Writer Qwen 3.8 2.4T, Flash backup (frozen-seed writer comparison 2026-10-11). Certification (operator 2026-10-09, non-blocking): every pair-accepted reasoning claim is checked immediately without a selector by one Qwen and one GLM certifier session in parallel (one claim per session, current text). Certified = both Qwen and GLM accept; any certifier reject or objection sends the claim back to needs-repair. The writer may state as proved only certified claims (writer-verified); pair-accepted uncertified claims are 'awaiting-audit' in CLAIMS-LEDGER.md and may only be stated conditionally; the final-report check enforces it. Operator 2026-10-10: ordinary critic sessions reserve one immutable revision per model family; typed notes/verdicts never result claims. Flash literature source evidence is checked once by K3 (source itself), no tie-break/selector/certifiers; mixed evidence is returned for splitting. Reasoning writer gate requires both Qwen and GLM ACCEPT on current revision. Freed on-demand review budget remains available for reasoning. Operator-only reports never flow to workers.
